purpose: 62 complete original NativeZipper executions of the 11-tape signed linear-form controller. Sixty deterministic cases cover all 25 coefficient pairs from u in [-3,-1,0,2,4] and v in [-2,0,1,-1,3], widths 0 through 6, both signs, zero coefficients, cancellation and product/addition wraparound. Two wider 16/32-bit cases use zero coefficients. All three inputs and products, both outputs, zero/fuel words, all markers, blank scratch, halt and all 11 unequal absolute head positions are checked. The oracle computes component products and sums independently in natural arithmetic, modulo the fixed width. Five work/output tapes start blank. Inputs/templates/fuel/scratch are supplied; raw input loading, four-call image composition and post-call work erasure are not claimed.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.SignedLinearFormRun
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine
open SignedLinearForm

def bits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map n.testBit

def portIndex : Port → Nat
  | .arg j => j.val | .zero => 3 | .fuel => 4 | .scratch => 5 | .work j => 6+j.val
  | .out b => if b then 10 else 9

def ports : List Port :=
  (List.finRange 3).map Port.arg ++ [.zero,.fuel,.scratch] ++
    (List.finRange 3).map Port.work ++ [.out false,.out true]

def heads (p : Port) : Int := 23*(portIndex p : Int)-157

def checkCase (u v : Int) (m P N D : Nat) : Bool :=
  let xs : Fin 3 → List Bool := ![bits m P,bits m N,bits m D]
  let values : Fin 3 → Nat := ![P%2^m,N%2^m,D%2^m]
  let products : Fin 3 → Nat := ![u.natAbs*values 0%2^m,u.natAbs*values 1%2^m,v.natAbs*values 2%2^m]
  let positive := (u.natAbs*(if u<0 then values 1 else values 0)+(if v<0 then 0 else v.natAbs*values 2))%2^m
  let negative := (u.natAbs*(if u<0 then values 0 else values 1)+(if v<0 then v.natAbs*values 2 else 0))%2^m
  let c := NativeZipper.run (program u v) (48*m+133+(2*u.natAbs+v.natAbs)*(18*m+52))
    (zipperCfg (.init 0 (.init (.erase 0))) (initial xs) heads)
  decide (c.core.pc=.done) &&
    (List.finRange 3).all (fun j => decide (c.core.tapes (.arg j)=Counter.marked (xs j))) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .zero=Counter.marked (List.replicate m false)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .fuel=Counter.marked [true]) &&
    decide ((c.core.tapes .scratch).left=[.start]) &&
    (c.core.tapes .scratch).right.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
    (List.finRange 3).all (fun j => decide (c.core.tapes (.work j)=Counter.marked (bits m (products j)))) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.out false)=Counter.marked (bits m positive)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.out true)=Counter.marked (bits m negative)) &&
    ports.all (fun p => decide (c.pos p=heads p))

def checks : Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut failures := 0
  let mut count := 0
  for seed in List.range 60 do
    let u : Int := ![-3,-1,0,2,4] ⟨seed%5,by omega⟩
    let v : Int := ![-2,0,1,-1,3] ⟨(seed/5)%5,by omega⟩
    let m := seed%7
    count := count+1
    if !checkCase u v m (11*seed+1) (7*seed+3) (5*seed+2) then failures := failures+1
  for m in [16,32] do
    count := count+1
    if !checkCase 0 0 m 123 77 45 then failures := failures+1
  return (count,failures)
#eval checks
